metadata.description: Connect to a Canopy server, and manage one.

plugins.name: canopy-connector
plugins.description: Connect to your Canopy server, find skills on it, move your standing instructions into it, and validate and benchmark the connection. The only Canopy plugin to install at user level.

plugins.name: canopy-habits
plugins.description: Your habits and SOPs in Canopy: capture a dictated rule, adopt example habits, write and run SOPs, and keep the CLAUDE.md block in step.

plugins.name: canopy-manager
plugins.description: Set up, run and diagnose a Canopy server. Deploy it on the server; add it at user level only while setting up.
